sandbox_page_description: Tools such as the web browser are MCP servers that run in a sandbox. Run your own on any computer with Docker and your turns use it first, whether you talk to Kaja on Telegram or in the terminal. Sharing it with others is up to you.
sandbox_key_description: The key links a sandbox to your account. Run the command on a computer with Docker; it connects out to Kaja, so no port needs opening.
sandbox_key_regenerate_description: Sandboxes started with the old key can't connect again until you restart them with the new one.
sandbox_key_shown_once: Copy it now: the key is only shown this once.
sandbox_limit_on: It lends at most 4 GB of memory and 2 CPUs, enough for 7 browsers at once. Change --memory and --cpus to lend more or less.
sandbox_limit_off: It may use the whole computer: it runs as many browsers as the memory fits, and turns new ones away when memory runs low.
sandbox_setting_share_hint: Other people who use shared sandboxes may run their tools in yours; you never see who they are. Turn it off to keep your sandboxes for your own tools.
sandbox_setting_use_shared_hint: When yours isn't online, your tools may run in someone else's. Its owner can see what runs there, so keep private things out of it. The browser stays on your own sandbox or the official one. Nothing of yours is kept there once your turn ends.
sandbox_mine_empty: None yet. Start one with your key and it shows up here.
sandbox_remove_description: It's offline; if it connects again it comes back as a new sandbox.
landing_sandbox_why: Some abilities need more than a chat: real web browsers, programs to run, open internet access. A sandbox runs them as local tools and MCP servers, so Kaja can use them wherever you talk to it, even from a Telegram chat. The terminal app doesn’t need one: it runs them right on your computer, with access to your files too.
landing_sandbox_how: Run one on your own computer and link it to your account, or use the shared ones others lend. Use the command as it is for an anonymous sandbox that everyone shares, or sign in for your own key. Lending yours to others is optional.
